verdict.rationale: Shortwave is an email client, so a webhook event-subscription story is a fair question for it. However, the evidence shows no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. The pack covers in-app triggers (draft replies, organize threads), MCP integrations and a Zapier connection used by the AI assistant, all of which are adjacent features rather than webhooks a programmatic consumer can subscribe to. Probes also found no published API spec.
